name: leadpages
description: Create and manage Leadpages landing pages and blog writers.

interface.longDescription: Leadpages helps marketers create and update branded landing pages, apply a saved brand kit, preview drafts in the Leadpages editor, and publish pages when asked. It also supports creating and managing recurring blog writers and blog content. A Leadpages account is required; publishing and writer scheduling depend on plan and workspace permissions.
defaultPrompt: Create a private landing-page draft in Leadpages using my brand kit.
Improve the headline on my Leadpages draft and keep the edits private.
Show the current status and editor link for my Leadpages page.
